decision.reasoning_trace: I started by filtering out accessories like cases, straps, and batteries, focusing only on actual speakers. My consideration set included the top-rated JBL models (Clip 3 and Charge 4) despite being renewed, as they offer premium sound. I also included highly-reviewed budget options like the EWA mini speaker, the INSMY waterproof speaker, and the comiso shower speaker. I decided to purchase the JBL Charge 4 (Renewed) because, at $89.95, it provides a significant upgrade in sound power and battery life compared to the ultra-portable mini speakers while still being a great value from a trusted brand.
